title: eXist-db project descriptor (.existdb.json)
description: Configuration for an eXist-db application worked on from disk: the servers it belongs to, how files sync to a collection, and (eXist-db Oxygen plugin extension) how it is built and installed. Shared with the eXist-db VS Code plugin / langserver, atom-existdb, xst and node-exist (which read the servers/sync connection).

servers.description: Named connections; the key is referenced by sync.server.

server.description: The eXist server root URL, e.g. http://localhost:8080/exist.

password.description: Password for the user (often empty for a local admin dev server).

sync.description: How files sync to a collection (used for Upload to eXist-db and upload-on-save).

server.description: Name of the servers entry to sync to.

root.description: Target collection the files are mirrored under, e.g. /db/apps/myapp.

onSave.description: When true, each saved file is uploaded to its mapped collection.

ignore.description: Glob patterns of files to skip (e.g. ".git/**", "node_modules/**").

dir.description: Subdirectory (relative to this file) treated as the sync root.

polling.description: Watch-and-sync via polling (consumed by some toolchains).

build.description: How the eXist-db Oxygen plugin builds and installs this app (plugin extension to the convention).

tool.description: The build tool. Optional — auto-detected from a build marker when absent.

command.description: The exact shell command to build, run through the login shell. Include any build-time arguments here, e.g. "ant -Dapp.version=1.0.0-dev". Defaults from tool when absent.

artifact.description: Glob locating the produced .xar (relative to this file), e.g. "build/*.xar". Defaults to the most recently built .xar when absent.

onSave.description: Auto-build this package when a file under it is saved in Oxygen. Off by default. The first auto-build prompts once to trust the project.

install.description: When onSave is set, also install the built .xar (via xst) to the resolved server after a successful auto-build. Off by default.
